content.about: Luxembourg is a small, landlocked country in Western Europe, between Belgium, France and Germany. It is the world's last grand duchy. Its capital is built on cliffs over deep river gorges. It is a major centre for banking and EU institutions.

standout.text: Luxembourg was the first country to make all public transport free, in 2020.

didYouKnow: Luxembourgish, French and German are all official languages.
It has one of the highest incomes per person in the world.
Luxembourg City's old quarters sit on steep rock fortifications.
